hook: Spain had never won a World Cup. Then this happened.
narration: Soccer City Stadium, Johannesburg. The 2010 World Cup Final. Spain versus the Netherlands. Spain had never won a World Cup. Fourteen yellow cards in one final. The match was brutal. Through 90 minutes, zero-zero. Extra time. The 116th minute. Last touch of the World Cup. Iniesta lifts his shirt. Dani Jarque siempre con nosotros. Spain are World Champions for the first time. LIKE if you remember watching this live. COMMENT your favourite World Cup moment.
title_options: The goal that ended 76 years of waiting
